purpose: Generic adapter behavior checks: timeouts, failures, malformed output, and safe success — proving adapters behave correctly on inputs not seen in fixtures.

generic_checks.shape: adapter call that exceeds its timeout on an unseen target
generic_checks.assertion: aborts at timeout; classified TOOL_FAILURE/ENVIRONMENT_FAILURE per F1; no hang

generic_checks.shape: adapter call whose target returns an error on an unseen input
generic_checks.assertion: classified with correct F1 code; evidence reference recorded

generic_checks.shape: adapter receives malformed output from an unseen target
adapter call that succeeds on an unseen input
generic_checks.assertion: typed result returned; timing within tolerance; no secret logged

generic_checks.shape: adapter configured with attempt_count=N on a flaky unseen target
generic_checks.assertion: retries exactly N times; final result/failure recorded

generic_checks.shape: adapter called with a secret-bearing input
generic_checks.assertion: logs redacted; no secret reaches evidence store

generic_checks.shape: static check: decision.py no longer calls subprocess/urllib directly for wrapped targets

generation_rule: adapter targets/inputs are freshly chosen; the invariants are timeout enforcement, F1 classification, redaction, attempt-count adherence, and lane routing
